title: Whether any en-route sector will run over the summer 2027 tolerance of ATM-related losses of separation, with each sector's summer 2026 delay, solo opening hours and ACAS encounters
subdomain: safety incident and error analysis (losses of separation in an area control centre's en-route sectors against a unit safety plan's tolerance)
prompt_shape: 01 (each candidate in or out against a line): every sector's summer 2027 forecast against the tolerance, with every sector's summer 2026 ATFM delay per flight, hours open on its own and ACAS RA encounters

No real person, operator, flight or occurrence is depicted.
